status: author-confirmed entrywise match to the model-exported similarity matrix
preparation_history: The local numerical matrix was initially reconstructed by matching cell colors in the existing Figure 5 image to its colorbar.
Corresponding off-diagonal entries were averaged to create a symmetric matrix; diagonal entries were set to one.
The author subsequently confirmed that the complete released matrix matches their model-exported similarity values entry by entry, not merely the rounded summary metrics of 0.479, 0.296, and 0.027.
domain_labels: The predefined domain categories shown in Figure 5; no clustering algorithm was fitted to choose these labels.
verification_scope: The evaluation script recomputes metrics from the supplied matrix. Model training and export are outside the scope of this analysis package.

author_confirmation.statement: The author reports having verified exact entrywise agreement between their model-exported values and the complete released matrix.
author_confirmation.scope: All entries of the 16-by-16 similarity matrix.
author_confirmation.basis: Author confirmation; a separate original model-export file was not inspected during this repository update.
